shared_elements: quadruped predator with forelimbs/claws shown gripping downward
human or anthropomorphic figure with arms and splayed fingers
animal head in profile with prominent muzzle and eye
elongated arms/hands with clearly rendered fingers
vertically stacked registers of creatures on an upright block
schematic small figure subordinate to a larger animal
justification: Both show the same distinctive combination of a large clawed predator positioned above and reaching over a smaller human-like head/figure, with hands and long fingers rendered as a recurrent motif, and both organise their creatures in stacked vertical tiers on an upright block. The clearest difference is that A additionally carries a whole repertoire of flat-relief profile birds, a row of repeated handled/bag-like signs and banded pattern registers, whereas B reduces the scheme to a few massive interlocked bodies carved in the round with no birds, bands or repeated signs.
